data.description: Upgraded | Burj Khalifa View | Large Layout
data.long_description:
Set in the heart of Imperial Avenue, this spacious 3-bedroom plus maid’s room apartment offers refined city living in one of Dubai’s most desirable addresses. Spanning 2,186.58 sqft, the residence is thoughtfully designed to provide generous living spaces, natural light, and a functional layout ideal for both end users and investors. 

The open-plan living and dining area creates a welcoming atmosphere for daily living and entertaining, while large windows frame impressive urban views and bring brightness throughout the home. The modern kitchen is designed for convenience and practicality, complemented by quality finishes and ample storage. All three bedrooms are well proportioned, offering privacy and comfort, while the maid’s room adds flexibility for staff accommodation, extra storage, or a utility space. With five bathrooms, the apartment delivers added convenience for families and guests. Positioned in the vibrant district of Downtown Dubai, residents enjoy seamless access to world-class shopping, dining, business hubs, and iconic landmarks including Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall. This property presents an excellent opportunity to enjoy premium urban living in a prime central location.

Features:

⦁ 3 Bedrooms + Maid’s Room
⦁ 5 Bathrooms
⦁ 2,186.58 sqft.
⦁ Spacious living and dining area
⦁ Modern kitchen with storage space
⦁ Large windows with abundant natural light
⦁ Well-planned family-friendly layout

⦁ Quality finishes throughout
⦁ Ideal for end users or investors

Amenities:

⦁ Swimming pool
